scope: Legacy KML and Shapefile ingestion parser, feature, and source-read failures

behavior.kml: Malformed XML and per-Placemark failures return bounded parser/exception-class summaries; source names and coordinate payloads are not copied into error results.
behavior.shapefile: Per-feature failures and source-open/iteration failures are bounded, class-only summaries and are logged without raw provider/file details.
behavior.counts: Existing successful-record counting and per-feature success/error collection remain in place; a source-read error returns partial when records already succeeded and error otherwise.

coverage: KML parser and feature failures omit private source text and contributor names
Shapefile feature and open failures omit provider/coordinate details from results and logs
legacy import module contracts remain available

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; temporary KML files and mocked Fiona readers

limitations: No live Fiona driver, database, or geospatial file was used.
The legacy adapters count/import records but do not persist farm geometry in this code path.
